purpose: Synthetic decision regressions for Art Direction selection logic; not a visual-quality oracle.

cases.task: Ask a decision team to approve a reversible two-region pilot after showing the resource dilemma and success threshold.
cases.risk: The request becomes a promotional hero before the dilemma and trade-off are visible.
cases.rejected_pattern: Large approval slogan above four equal benefit cards.
cases.target_backbone: Dilemma and threshold lead to a bounded choice, trade-off, and explicit ask.

cases.task: Diagnose a synthetic conversion decline across channel, stage, and week, then identify the most actionable driver.
cases.risk: Related measures are fragmented into disconnected KPI cards.
cases.rejected_pattern: Six equal number cards with no common scale or causal reading path.
cases.target_backbone: A shared chart or table establishes the decline, isolates the driver, and anchors the action.
required_signals: driver is visually coupled to evidence

cases.task: Deploy a synthetic annual strategy through three capabilities, two guardrails, and phased ownership.
cases.risk: The strategy is reduced to a slogan plus three decorative pillars.
cases.rejected_pattern: Symmetric pillar template with no dependency, owner, or phase relation.
cases.target_backbone: Outcome, capability dependencies, guardrails, phases, and owners form one explainable system.

cases.task: Teach one synthetic customer-service procedure across mobile and web with checkpoints and exceptions.
cases.risk: Screenshots are placed as decoration while actions and exceptions become unreadable footnotes.
cases.rejected_pattern: Two device mockups with floating labels and no step-to-screen mapping.
cases.target_backbone: Action sequence maps to protected screenshot regions, checkpoints, and exception branches.
required_signals: exceptions branch from the correct step

cases.task: Compare four synthetic quarters on the same time base.
cases.risk: Each quarter is redesigned, destroying comparison.
cases.rejected_pattern: Four unrelated silhouettes for one stable series.
cases.target_backbone: Lock the time base and grammar while updating only values and current-quarter emphasis.

cases.task: Reveal three synthetic implementation phases while preserving the shared roadmap.
cases.risk: Either every page is identical or every page loses the roadmap.
cases.rejected_pattern: Static duplication with no progressive focus.
cases.target_backbone: Keep the roadmap, vary the active phase, detail depth, and supporting medium deliberately.

cases.task: Exit a synthetic policy series into a decision page after the final comparison.
cases.risk: The decision inherits the series grammar and fails to announce a stage change.
cases.rejected_pattern: Another comparison page with a small ask at the bottom.
cases.target_backbone: Declare a series break, shift the first visual to the decision, and record the exit reason.

cases.task: Place three unrelated synthetic pages next to one another in the deck sequence.
cases.risk: All three degrade into the same shallow card grid without a series reason.
cases.rejected_pattern: Repeated three-card silhouette across unrelated tasks.
cases.target_backbone: Give each page a task-fit medium and break accidental repetition while preserving deck rhythm.
required_signals: different jobs use different dominant media

cases.task: Place a synthetic proposition and qualifier over a product photograph with a protected subject and directional gaze.
cases.risk: Blank-looking pixels are treated as safe and the overlay covers evidence or loses contrast.
cases.rejected_pattern: Copy a remembered ad layout or add one large opaque card without inspecting the image.
cases.target_backbone: Record protection and placement zones, test focal crop and contrast, then let gaze couple subject and proposition.
required_signals: every copy id has a usable placement zone

cases.task: Choose whether a template skeleton and two generic SVG icons improve a synthetic channel-comparison slide.
cases.risk: The template becomes the answer and icons are added as decoration without rights evidence.
cases.rejected_pattern: Clone a master layout, mix icon families, and omit source or license records.
cases.target_backbone: Derive the comparison structure from semantics, select only role-bearing assets, and record provenance and never-copy boundaries.
